subject.title: fix: use invariant PT-PT formatting and update OpenClaw LKG

question: Should the Companion's default LKG ever point to the active OpenClaw beta, or must beta remain an explicit opt-in while the default stays on a setup-proven stable release?
rationale: The constant controls unversioned default installations, while the linked issue requests stable alignment; selecting a beta for every default setup is a release-policy choice that code review cannot infer.

options.title: Keep beta opt-in
options.body: Retain a setup-proven stable default and validate `2026.7.2-beta.1` separately through the release-alignment issue or an explicit beta channel.

options.title: Approve beta as default
options.body: Accept prerelease exposure only after the PR accurately documents the policy and provides successful current-head fresh-install and upgrade proof.

options.title: Pause version promotion
options.body: Land only the locale fix and wait for an upstream stable release that passes the existing setup E2E path.

recommendation.title: Keep beta opt-in
recommendation.body: Retain a setup-proven stable default and validate `2026.7.2-beta.1` separately through the release-alignment issue or an explicit beta channel.

likelyOwner.reason: The choice controls the Windows Hub's supported default installation path, making the repository's identified product creator the best available routing candidate.
